description.value: Terrace Beach Resort is a collection of individually named beachfront cabins and elevated boardwalk lofts nestled in the Pacific rainforest on the sheltered tip of the Ucluelet peninsula. Units are designed in a rustic-elegant style with open-beam construction, fireplaces, and kitchens or kitchenettes, many with private hot tubs or soaker tubs. The resort sits steps from the Wild Pacific Trail's Lighthouse Loop, making it a natural base for cyclists exploring the wild west coast of Vancouver Island.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is available and confirms the resort is a real, operating collection of vacation cabins/cottages in Ucluelet, BC. The accommodations page explicitly lists amenities included with all properties: Kitchen/Kitchenette, Free Parking, Pet Friendly, High-Speed Wifi, and Self Check-in. No mention of bike storage, bike procedures, laundry, drying areas, or cycling-specific services anywhere on the site; the self check-in model implies limited on-site staff presence. Address confirmed by website footer; phone not visible in scraped content so contact_confirmed.phone is null.
concerns: Self check-in model noted on accommodations page — on-site staffing may be limited or absent, which could affect ability to arrange bike storage or get cycling assistance.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating resort confirmed by active website with multiple named units, direct trail access, and all-properties amenity list. Strong candidate for touring cyclists riding the Wild Pacific coast.

Nearby evening food.detail: Website states 'easy access to the town of Ucluelet for dining, shops, and local attractions.'
